unauthorized_artifact_present.worker10_action: left it untouched after the first report (one link in it was fixed while the file was still believed to be worker-10's own), and removed every link from worker-10 pages that pointed at it. Reported to lead for Boss-level disposition.

bucket_authority.rule: worker-10 pages never hard-code a namespace->bucket table of their own; every api/<bucket>/ href is checked against the buckets the artifact can produce

intentional_carve_out_buckets.why: These 7 entry-point types are routed by exact type name so a modder opening the site lands on the 5 types they actually subclass. They are NOT duplicate routes and NOT a navigation bug: each type has exactly one page (one type = one path).
intentional_carve_out_buckets.do_not: Do not 'fix' mission/ or core/ by moving those pages back into mission-ext/ or core-extra/. That would delete the only index that names them.
intentional_carve_out_buckets.bucket_index_requirement: mission/_index.md and core/_index.md must state at the top that the bucket only holds mod entry-point types and that the full API lives in ../mission-ext/ and ../core-extra/, and must link both ways.

no_gameplay_bucket.decision: Do not create a gameplay/ bucket.
no_gameplay_bucket.reason: 1.4.5/gameplay/ is semantically mixed (it holds SandBox, StoryMode.* and bare TaleWorlds.MountAndBlade types); no namespace rule can reproduce it. Recreating it would copy the defect.
no_gameplay_bucket.parity_gap: Cite the artifact's structured parityGaps array verbatim in the architecture pages; do not restate it as prose.
no_gameplay_bucket.accepted_cost: The 19 URLs of 1.4.5/gameplay/ have no v1.4.6 counterpart. SandBox* -> sandbox/ and StoryMode* -> storymode/ match the real namespaces.

never_create: ModuleManager.md — no such type exists in any version (0 hits across 1.4.5 8583 / 1.4.6 11385 / 1.4.7 11387 / 1.5.3 11487 .cs files). modulemanager/ is a bucket of OTHER types (ModuleInfo, SubModuleInfo, ModuleHelper, ModuleCategory, ModuleType, DependedModule, Extensions, IPlatformModuleExtension).

how_navigation_actually_works.verified_by: reading templates/macros/sidebar.html, templates/partials/sidebar.html, templates/partials/topnav.html, templates/macros/breadcrumb.html, templates/macros/page-navigation.html, templates/page.html, tools/generate-section-tree.mjs, tools/_regen_nav.mjs, tools/generate-relkey-map.mjs, tools/generate-section-indexes.mjs, data/navigation.json, data/section-tree.json
how_navigation_actually_works.version_switch: nav.meta.versions is the switch. Until v1.4.6 is listed there, templates/partials/topnav.html never renders a v1.4.6 dropdown entry and templates/macros/sidebar.html refuses to treat /v1.4.6/<lang>/ as a language root, so every v1.4.6 URL falls into the flat 'Site Navigation' fallback.
how_navigation_actually_works.version_dropdown_target: data/relkey_map.json (same-relkey target across versions); without a v1.4.6 entry it falls back to the language root, so switching version from a class page throws you back to the landing page
how_navigation_actually_works.sidebar: renders only routes whose node.parent == '/vX/lang/' AND whose node.group matches a key of nav.groups; children come from node.children (mirrored from section-tree subsections) and from section-tree.byRoute[...].subsections. Leaf routes may keep group null; section roots may not.
how_navigation_actually_works.breadcrumb: uses Zola item.ancestors + get_section(); needs a real _index.md at every ancestor level
how_navigation_actually_works.parent_and_prev_next: templates/macros/page-navigation.html reads Zola parent_section.pages; automatic once the page and its section _index.md exist. Never hand-write prev/next into page bodies.
how_navigation_actually_works.generated_not_handwritten: data/section-tree.json is generated by tools/generate-section-tree.mjs; data/navigation.json routes by tools/_regen_nav.mjs (preserving label/group); data/relkey_map.json by tools/generate-relkey-map.mjs from a hard-coded VERSIONS list; data/page-navigation.json by tools/generate-page-navigation.mjs

patches.why: THE switch. Both the version dropdown and the sidebar language-root computation gate on nav.meta.versions. Nothing else in the pipeline can make v1.4.6 appear. _regen_nav.mjs copies existing.meta verbatim, so the edit survives regeneration.
Generated from content/. Until it is regenerated, tools/audit-navigation.mjs fails with 'missing section route /v1.4.6/...'. Never hand-edit.
Creates the /v1.4.6/... routes with the correct parent/children derived from the section tree.

route_entry_naming_rule.shape: "/<version>/<lang>/<section>/" — one entry per SECTION, never per leaf page
route_entry_naming_rule.leaf_entries: No leaf entries. Existing versions have none: all 464 routes in data/navigation.json are section roots (e.g. /v1.3.15/zh/api/campaign/), and /v1.4.5/zh/api/campaign/ has children: 0 while its 40+ class pages are reached through section-tree.byRoute[...].subsections. Leaf pages are therefore auto-derived by the sidebar; adding leaf entries would duplicate them.
route_entry_naming_rule.fields: { label: {zh, en}, group, collapsed, order, parent, children }
route_entry_naming_rule.parent_rule: parent is the route minus its last segment: /v1.4.6/zh/architecture/ -> parent /v1.4.6/zh/
route_entry_naming_rule.children_rule: children = the section tree's subsections; _regen_nav.mjs fills this automatically
route_entry_naming_rule.label_rule: zh and en labels must both be present; the version dropdown reads label[lang]. v1.4.5 uses {zh:"Bannerlord v1.4.5", en:"Bannerlord v1.4.5"} for the three roots and {zh:"API 参考", en:"API Reference"} / {zh:"架构总览", en:"Architecture"} for the sections.
route_entry_naming_rule.group_rule: See follow_up below — this is the one thing regeneration does NOT get right.

follow_up.problem: For brand-new routes _regen_nav.mjs uses group = ex?.group ?? null, i.e. null. templates/macros/sidebar.html renders a route only when node.parent == root_key AND node.group == group_key, so every v1.4.6 route left at null is invisible in the sidebar. Symptom looks like 'the template is broken' but the template is fine.
follow_up.mirror_of: exactly the group values v1.4.5 already carries (start for the language roots, api / architecture / guide / native / xml for the sections)
follow_up.leaf_note: Do not bother setting group on leaf or bucket routes: the sidebar reaches them through the parent's children list, which is why 119 of the v1.4.5 routes are legitimately group:null.

ROOTS is hard-coded to 1.3.0 / 1.3.15 / 1.4.5, so it cannot emit a 1.4.6 column; that is why version-delta.md states signature-level deltas are not verified. Also note per brief 3: the local bannerlord-1.4.5/ has no C# source, so this tool returns not found for 1.4.5 anyway — compare against bannerlord-1.3.15 and say '1.4.5 not verified'.

bidirectional_reachability.principle: Links are ROUTE-relative: a page route is its own directory, so one '..' pops exactly one path segment. fs.existsSync on the joined path is not a valid existence check — a wrong-level link exists as a file.

levels.note: pops == number of segments in the OWN route; the language segment must match the TARGET tree

forbidden: content/ anywhere in an href (repo-root-relative leakage)
a version segment inside a SAME-version link
../<bucket>/<Name> from an api leaf page — one level short, only reachable as a sibling
./<Name> from a leaf page — dot-slash is legal only from a bucket _index.md
more ../ than the page's own route segment count
linking to content/v1.4.6/_index.md — unauthorized artifact, undefined language ownership
bidirectional_reachability.note_on_the_anchored_grep: The anchored check `grep -nE '\]\(\.\./[a-z-]+/[A-Za-z]'` is defined for api LEAF pages, where a single-level ../<bucket>/<Name> is one level short. Architecture pages legitimately use ../../api/<bucket>/<Name> (brief section 2), so the pattern must be scoped to content/v1.4.6/*/*/api/** and not run over architecture pages, or it reports false positives.
